---
title: "Structural Bioinformatics"
---

This site is the HTML edition of *Structural Bioinformatics*, built from the same LaTeX sources as the PDF (`main.tex` and `chapters/`). Chapters are generated before each render (`python3 website/quarto_gen.py` via `pre-render`).

For the print-oriented PDF, build with `latexmk -pdf main.tex` as described in the repository README.
